population.span: VERTIS CV was a randomized, double-blind, multicenter trial in patients with T2DM (glycohemoglobin 7.0%–10.5%) and established ASCVD, including coronary, cerebrovascular, and peripheral vascular disease

endpoint.span: Time to first hospitalization for heart failure ( A )

estimate.span: The outcome of risk for first HHF was lower in patients on ertugliflozin (pooled doses) versus placebo (139/5499 [2.5%] versus 99/2747 [3.6%]; HR, 0.70 [95% CI, 0.54–0.90]; P =0.006).

ci.span: The outcome of risk for first HHF was lower in patients on ertugliflozin (pooled doses) versus placebo (139/5499 [2.5%] versus 99/2747 [3.6%]; HR, 0.70 [95% CI, 0.54–0.90]; P =0.006).

analysis_set.span: Analyses were performed on an intention-to-treat basis using all randomly assigned patients and all time on-study for each patient comparing the effects of pooled ertugliflozin versus placebo.

treatment_strategy.span: Patients were randomly assigned in a 1:1:1 ratio to ertugliflozin 5 mg, ertugliflozin 15 mg, or matching placebo once daily added to background standard-of-care diabetes therapy.

follow_up.span: Patients were followed for a mean of 3.5 years (median 3.0 years).

entry_population_matches_question.why: The entry population had T2DM and established ASCVD, included participants with and without baseline HF, and the estimate used all randomized patients.
entry_population_matches_question.span: A total of 8246 patients were randomly assigned to ertugliflozin (n=5499) or placebo (n=2747); n=1958 (23.7%) had previous HF and n=5006 (60.7%) had pretrial EF available, including n=959 with EF ≤45%.

notes: Bound from the held full-text VERTIS CV HF report (PMID 33026243), linked to the main trial report by trial name and NCT01986881. The served numbers match the pooled-dose first-HHF ITT result. Registry eligibility specifies minimum age 40 years. No registry spans were needed for the seven fields.
